title: No cleanup of parents dict entries over time
description: File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py. The parents dict grows as neighbors are heard but entries are only removed on: (1) poisoned DIO, (2) explicit remove_parent(), (3) version change. Long-running nodes may accumulate stale parent entries for neighbors that went silent. Consider a max-age or LRU eviction for parent candidates, or rely on caller to call remove_parent() on link timeout.
